entities.name: Sliver Lair
entities.description: Cave and duct nest of the Sliver Queen and her brood in the Hub on Rath.

entities.name: Sliver Queen
entities.description: Queen of the slivers nesting in the lair.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship that passed through the lair.

entities.name: Weatherlight Crew
entities.description: Crew that split apart to weaken the slivers.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Phenomenon that placed the lair in a volcano.

events.summary: The Weatherlight enters an exhaust vent in the Cinder Marsh and is swarmed by slivers.
The crew splits apart to force the slivers to spread out and passes through.
The Rathi Overlay places the lair in the heart of a volcano, destroying it.
events.quote: The Sliver Lair was destroyed when the Rathi Overlay placed it in the heart of a volcano.

relations.note: Her hive was in its deepest part.
relations.quote: In the deepest part of the lair the Sliver Queen had her hive
